nodes.name: branches.rs
nodes.summary: Axum route handlers for branch operations: list branches, get current branch name, create/delete/rename branches, and checkout a ref.

nodes.name: commits.rs
nodes.summary: Axum route handlers for commit history and creation: list commits with pagination/file filtering, create a commit, and amend the last commit.

nodes.name: diff.rs
nodes.summary: Axum route handlers covering file content, diffs (single/batch/staged), diff summaries and numstat, commit diffs, and blame, delegating the actual git work to the commands crate.

nodes.name: file.rs
nodes.summary: Route handlers for raw git file status and mtime lookups, spawning git CLI commands directly (bypassing git2/commands) and mapping stage/blob-hash query params.

nodes.name: merge.rs
nodes.summary: Axum route handlers for merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, and reset operations (plus their abort/continue variants), each a thin wrapper delegating to the commands crate.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregates all domain route modules (status, branches, commits, remotes, staging, stash, diff, merge, file, worktrees) into a single Axum Router plus a root API-info endpoint.

nodes.name: routes
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum Router mapping branch-related HTTP endpoints to their handler functions.

nodes.name: get_branches
nodes.summary: Handler that lists all branches for a repository via commands::list_branches.

nodes.name: get_current_branch_name
nodes.summary: Handler returning the repository's current branch name.

nodes.name: create_branch
nodes.summary: Handler that creates a new branch via commands::create_branch.

nodes.name: delete_branch
nodes.summary: Handler that deletes a branch by name via commands::delete_branch.

nodes.name: rename_branch
nodes.summary: Handler that renames a branch via commands::rename_branch.

nodes.name: checkout
nodes.summary: Handler that checks out a ref (branch/commit) via commands::checkout_ref.

nodes.name: routes
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum Router mapping commit-related HTTP endpoints to their handlers.

nodes.name: get_commits
nodes.summary: Handler listing commit history with pagination and optional file-path filtering via commands::list_commits.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Handler that creates a new commit via commands::create_commit.

nodes.name: amend_commit
nodes.summary: Handler that amends the last commit's message/files via commands::amend_commit.

nodes.name: routes
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum Router mapping diff, blame, and file-content endpoints to their handlers.

nodes.name: get_file_content
nodes.summary: Handler returning a file's blob content at a given ref via commands::get_file_content.

nodes.name: get_file_diff
nodes.summary: Handler returning a single file's diff between two refs via commands::get_file_diff.

nodes.name: get_batch_file_diffs
nodes.summary: Handler returning diffs for multiple files in a single request via commands::get_batch_file_diffs.

nodes.name: get_staged_diff
nodes.summary: Handler returning the diff of currently staged changes via commands::get_staged_diff.

nodes.name: get_diff_summary
nodes.summary: Handler returning a summary (files changed, insertions/deletions) between two refs via commands::get_diff_summary.

nodes.name: get_diff_numstat
nodes.summary: Handler returning per-file added/deleted line counts between refs via commands::get_diff_numstat.

nodes.name: get_diff_numstat_combined
nodes.summary: Handler returning combined working-tree + staged numstat (optionally including untracked files) via commands::get_diff_numstat_combined.

nodes.name: get_commit_diff
nodes.summary: Handler returning the full diff for a specific commit via commands::get_commit_diff, with error mapping for missing commits.

nodes.name: get_blame
nodes.summary: Handler returning per-line blame info for a file via commands::get_blame.

nodes.name: map_commit_diff_error
nodes.summary: Maps commands::get_commit_diff error strings to the appropriate GitApiError variant (e.g. commit not found).

nodes.name: map_file_content_error
nodes.summary: Maps commands::get_file_content error strings to the appropriate GitApiError variant (e.g. file not found at ref).

nodes.name: spawn_git_command
nodes.summary: Spawns a git CLI subprocess with the given args in a repo directory and returns its output.

nodes.name: FileRouteError
nodes.summary: Local error enum (GitError, IoError, InvalidRequest) for the file-status/mtime routes with its own IntoResponse mapping to HTTP status codes.

nodes.name: parse_stage_number
nodes.summary: Parses a merge-conflict stage number (1/2/3) from a query string value.

nodes.name: parse_blob_hash
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a git blob hash from a query string value.

nodes.name: get_file_mtime_internal
nodes.summary: Reads a file's filesystem modification time as a Unix timestamp.

nodes.name: get_git_file_status
nodes.summary: Handler computing a file's tracked/staged status, blob hash, mtime, and conflict stage by directly invoking git CLI commands rather than the commands crate.

nodes.name: get_file_mtime
nodes.summary: Handler returning a file's modification time via get_file_mtime_internal.

nodes.name: routes
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum Router mapping file-status and file-mtime endpoints to their handlers.

nodes.name: routes
nodes.summary: Builds the Axum Router mapping merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, and reset endpoints (plus a task-streaming route) to their handlers.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Handler that merges a branch into HEAD via commands::merge_branch.

nodes.name: merge_abort
nodes.summary: Handler that aborts an in-progress merge via commands::merge_abort.

nodes.name: merge_continue
nodes.summary: Handler that continues a merge after conflict resolution via commands::merge_continue.

nodes.name: rebase
nodes.summary: Handler that rebases the current branch onto an upstream ref via commands::rebase_branch.

nodes.name: rebase_abort
nodes.summary: Handler that aborts an in-progress rebase via commands::rebase_abort.

nodes.name: rebase_continue
nodes.summary: Handler that continues a rebase after conflict resolution via commands::rebase_continue.

nodes.name: cherry_pick
nodes.summary: Handler that cherry-picks a commit via commands::cherry_pick_commit.

nodes.name: cherry_pick_abort
nodes.summary: Handler that aborts an in-progress cherry-pick via commands::cherry_pick_abort.

nodes.name: cherry_pick_continue
nodes.summary: Handler that continues a cherry-pick after conflict resolution via commands::cherry_pick_continue.

nodes.name: revert
nodes.summary: Handler that reverts a commit via commands::revert_commit.

nodes.name: revert_abort
nodes.summary: Handler that aborts an in-progress revert via commands::revert_abort.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Handler that resets HEAD to a target ref with a given mode via commands::reset_head.

nodes.name: create_routes
nodes.summary: Merges every domain-specific sub-router (status, branches, commits, remotes, staging, stash, diff, merge, file, worktrees) into the top-level Git API Axum Router.

nodes.name: api_info
nodes.summary: Root endpoint returning basic API metadata (name, version, status, key endpoint URLs).
